blocks.orig: The beautiful Lake Duluti Lodge is located amidst Arusha’s coffee plantations, and this is luxury bliss. It’s a beautifully designed, luxury lodge with rooms boasting sumptuous beds and a luxury bathroom with a stand-alone bathtub. Furthermore, the lodge offers a wonderful lounge connected to a beautiful restaurant served by a high-end kitchen. Hidden between de coffee plants outside, you find a swimming pool and a spa for relaxing massages. If you want a wonderful & peaceful start to your holiday, this is the place to be!
blocks.html: Set among the coffee plantations of Arusha, the lovely Lake Duluti Lodge is pure luxury. This beautifully designed luxury lodge has rooms with lavish beds and a luxurious bathroom with a free-standing bathtub. There is also a wonderful lounge that opens onto an attractive restaurant with a high-end kitchen. Tucked away between the coffee plants outside are a swimming pool and a spa for relaxing massages. Looking for a lovely & calm start to your holiday? Then this is the place for you!
